title: WPScan
summary: WordPress vulnerability scanner and vulnerability-database service.
whyThisMatters: The project helped make WordPress-specific vulnerability information and testing workflows more accessible. It illustrates the value of ecosystem-focused security tooling.

sections.overview:
WPScan is a security scanner focused on WordPress installations.

Vulnerability data

The WPScan API provides vulnerability data for WordPress versions, plugins, and themes.

The scanner is documented as a black-box tool for security professionals and site maintainers.

Role

Its WordPress focus reflects the importance of component inventory and timely updates in widely deployed web platforms.

timeline.event: WPScan is documented as a security tool.
